On a slower Git Bash installation, the new jq probes can push the elapsed time beyond that window and fail pre-commit even when the wait budget is correct. Calculate the expected budget from the elapsed time for each invocation, or give these assertions the same startup tolerance as the changed pre-flight cases. > > > > > Also applies to: 1132-1132, 2007-2007 > > > >
